# QR generator

Source: https://github.com/Greaby/godot-qrcode-generator

Pinned commit: `08f15cf0f0c643ee3bdf661a2c4c78cdc3084c7b`.

The three GDScript classes are vendored unchanged under MIT (see LICENSE).
FirstOpenView adds a four-module white quiet zone and nearest-neighbor scaling.
QR payloads are locally generated demonstration references, never public invitation URLs.
